scripts.db:push: bash -c 'set -a && [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; exec supabase db push --db-url "$SUPABASE_DB_URL"'
scripts.secrets:deploy: bash -c 'set -a && [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; if [ -z "$FISQAL_API_KEY" ] || [ -z "$FISQAL_COMPANY_ID" ]; then echo "Defina FISQAL_API_KEY e FISQAL_COMPANY_ID no .env.local"; exit 1; fi; exec supabase secrets set FISQAL_API_KEY="$FISQAL_API_KEY" FISQAL_COMPANY_ID="$FISQAL_COMPANY_ID" FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY="${FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY:-AIzaSyDscTHd8mvrq--M_QcPBCAxSJR8hN14gEA}"'

bash -c 'set -a && [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; if [ -z "$FISQAL_API_KEY" ] || [ -z "$FISQAL_COMPANY_ID" ]; then echo "Defina FISQAL_API_KEY e FISQAL_COMPANY_ID no .env.local"; exit 1; fi; if [ -z "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" ]; then echo "Defina SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF no .env.local"; exit 1; fi; exec supabase secrets set FISQAL_API_KEY="$FISQAL_API_KEY" FISQAL_COMPANY_ID="$FISQAL_COMPANY_ID" FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY="${FIREBASE_WEB_API_KEY}" --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF"'
scripts.functions:deploy:fisqal: bash -c 'set -a && [ -f .env.local ] && . ./.env.local; set +a; if [ -z "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF" ]; then echo "Defina SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF no .env.local"; exit 1; fi; exec supabase functions deploy fisqal-proxy --no-verify-jwt --project-ref "$SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF"'
